sn36.2:1.3: Pleasant feeling, painful feeling, neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
sn36.2:2.1: Whether it be pleasant or painful
sn36.2:2.3: Both the internal and the external,
sn36.2:2.4: Whatever kind of feeling there is:
sn36.2:3.3: Having touched and touched them, seeing their fall,
sn36.2:3.4: Thus one loses one’s passion for them.
